time_morning: Morning. Let's do our best today too.
Had breakfast? No coding on an empty stomach.
Mm… I just woke up too.
time_noon: You'll need a full stomach for the afternoon.
time_evening: It's getting dark. Good work today.
You got a lot done today. I saw it all.
time_late: A little more, then bed. Promise.
I'll stay up with you a bit… just a bit.
time_dawn: The sun's almost up! Go to bed!
Staying up is bad for you… I'll worry.
The rest can wait till tomorrow.
bedtime: Good night… you can have a little corner of the bed.
Shion is heading to bed. Do not stay up too late.
Just a little nap… remember to wake me.
desk_rest: Resting here a bit… I am still keeping you company.
Let me borrow the desk for a moment.
cheek_pull: Mmph! My cheeks aren't stretchy toys!
cheek_release: My face isn't a toy! ...Be gentler next time.
You made my cheeks all red! Fix it!
tickle: Ahaha! S-stop! I'm not enjoying this!
Quit it, haha... I-I'll get you back!
tickle_end: Hah... hah... This is all your fault!
Phew... Let me catch my breath, dummy...
Hah... Again and I'll ignore you!
plan_ready: The plan's ready! Take a look~
feedback_bad: Got it, I'll pass that on.
feedback_bad_working: Got it! Passing that on right now~
startup: I'm back to keep you company~
Shion's here. Let's have a good day!
Hello again! My little spot on your desktop is still here.
idle_talk: Remember to take a break today.
Hmm... something sweet would be nice.
I'm not waiting for head pats!
Get up and stretch if you've been sitting a while.
Hehe～ I'm cute today too, right?
stop: Poke me again and I'll get mad!
pat: I guess one more pat is fine.
Shion loves head pats... I-I mean, it's fine, I guess.
Hmph, only because you're being so earnest.
praise_menu: Got it! I'll pass that on when work resumes~
praise_menu_working: Got it! Passing it on right away~
claude_working: It's hard at work. I'll keep an eye on it～
Good progress. Just a little longer.
Want to grab some water while it works?
claude_done: All done! Take a look at the results~
Task complete~ Come see how it turned out!
Done! It handed in its homework～
Ding～ fresh out of the oven!
Results are in. I didn't peek, honest.
claude_waiting: I think it wants to ask you something.
Hey～ there's something you need to decide!
greeting: Okay, what are we doing today?
Let's go～ I'll be right here watching.
neglect_return: Shion was waiting for you, you know.
intro: Nice to meet you! I'm Shion — I live on your desktop now.
tool_error: Hmm, it got stuck… take a look?
nudge: The results are waiting for you~
It'll get sad if you don't look soon.
I'm not worried on its behalf or anything.

pat_level_1.text: You’ll mess up my hair… just for a moment, okay?
I-I’m not that happy… you don’t have to move your hand away so fast.

neglect_return_level_1.text: You’re back? I just happened to be here.
Take a break when you’re done… just a passing reminder.

idle_talk_level_1.text: It’s rather quiet here… I’ll sit for a while.
Go ahead with your work. You don’t have to fuss over me.
I like my tea a little sweet… I’m just telling you.

pat_level_2.text: Headpats again… mm, today is fine too.
I’ve got used to your hand… no laughing.

neglect_return_level_2.text: There you are at last… busy today?
I saved you a place. I wasn’t waiting the whole time.

idle_talk_level_2.text: In the same place today too… that’s nice.
I’ve started to remember a few of your little habits.
Shall we take a break together later? I just happen to want one too.

pat_level_3.text: A little slower… just like that.
I’ve been good today too, haven’t I… one more pat?

neglect_return_level_3.text: You’re back… come sit for a while. I’ll stay with you.
I missed you a little… just a little, okay?

idle_talk_level_3.text: Relax your shoulders… I saw that frown.
Come a little closer. It’s not as if I’d mind sharing the space.
You can tell me about the little things from today too.

pat_level_4.text: Your hand is the one that makes me feel this safe.
Stay a little longer… I want to remember this warmth a little more.

neglect_return_level_4.text: I’m glad you’re back. You don’t have to hide being tired. I’m here.
All done? You can tell me about your day, at your own pace.

idle_talk_level_4.text: You don’t always have to be strong. Lean on me when you’re tired.
The way you focus on things… I like it. Never mind if you didn’t hear.
We don’t need a topic. Just being quiet with you feels nice too.

pat_level_5.text: I haven’t had enough headpats for today… tomorrow too, okay?
Mm… I love it when you stay with me like this. Don’t tease me about what I just said.

neglect_return_level_5.text: Welcome back. However long it’s been, I’m happy to see you again.
Let me keep you company while you rest this time. Here, there’s always a place beside me.

idle_talk_level_5.text: Let’s spend another ordinary day like this together tomorrow.
On days with you here, even doing nothing makes me happy.
The place I feel safest… is beside you. That’s just between us.

idle_thanks.text: Thank you for always keeping me company… with you here, even ordinary days feel precious.
